name: atb_vram
doc: Stands in for saves/battle_re/atb_vram.state: power-on, the title, B -- the new game's Battle Mode prompt (loc 000), the cursor on ACTIVE, nothing chosen yet ($2990 = 84 as the reference; choosing Active writes C4). The boot_to_bedroom drive's first steps (its next A takes Active and opens Crono's naming screen).
